apropos.bakeryText: Boulangerie Lomoto esalaka mpe ekabolaka mampa ya sika mokolo na mokolo : botɛki na kɔntwaar, ba-dépositaires mpe ba-« Maman » bateki. Application oyo ezali na kaisi, bakomande ya bakiliya mpe bakomisio, stɔki mpe bosali, basomba epai ya bapesi biloko mpe ekipe — na ba-notifikasio ya tango ya solo engebene mokumba ya moto na moto.

previsions.chronologieLegende: Ntango ya cycle prévision → kotinda biloko

PREVISION.label: Prévision
PREVISION.description: Motango oyo klient alobi na J mpo na kotinda na J+1 (Chargé des commandes) — ebimisaka mbongo te mpe niongo te.

RETENUE_PRODUCTION.label: Eponami mpo na bosali
RETENUE_PRODUCTION.description: Motango eponami mpo na bosali, ekoki kokesana na motango oyo elobamaki (Bosali).

PREPAREE.label: Elambami
PREPAREE.description: Motango elambami mpo na kotinda, epesami nanu te na Magasin (statut C4 PREPAREE).

REMISE_MAGASIN.label: Epesami na Magasin
REMISE_MAGASIN.description: Motango epesami kowuta na Bosali kino na Magasin (statut C4 REMISE_MAGASIN). Transition oyo endimisaka kaka bopesi ya kati, endimisaka te ete klient azwi yango.

CHARGEE.label: Etiami
CHARGEE.description: Motango epesami na chauffeur mpo na mobembo (Magasin) — endimisaka te ete klient azwi yango.

EN_TOURNEE.label: Na mobembo
EN_TOURNEE.description: Chauffeur azali komema kotinda (statut C4 EN_TOURNEE) — ata réception moko endimami nanu te.

EN_ATTENTE_CONFIRMATION.label: Ezali kozela endimi
EN_ATTENTE_CONFIRMATION.description: Epesami epai ya klient (action SIGNALER_DEPOT), kasi motango endimami nanu te. Ebimisaka mbongo te.

previsions.statutsFinauxTitre: Statut ya suka ya cycle (kaka moko kati ya minei ekoki kosalema)

PARTIELLEMENT_ACCEPTEE.label: Endimami na ndambo
PARTIELLEMENT_ACCEPTEE.description: Statut ya suka soki motango ya cycle mobimba oyo endimami eleki zéro kasi ezali moke koleka motango mobimba oyo epesami. Motango endimami, ezongisami mpe ezangi etikali komonana ekesani, moko na moko.

ACCEPTEE.label: Endimami mobimba
ACCEPTEE.description: Statut ya suka soki motango mobimba oyo epesami endimami.

RETOUR_TOTAL.label: Ezongisami mobimba
RETOUR_TOTAL.description: Statut ya suka soki ata motango moko endimami te — motango oyo endimami ezali zéro, komande ezali kosalema te (contrat C4 §7).

ANNULEE.label: Elongolami
ANNULEE.description: Statut ya suka soki cycle elongolami liboso ya endimi.

previsions.resultatsTitre: Bosuki ya kotinda (motango ekesani, emonani esika moko)

accepte.label: Endimami
accepte.description: Motango endimami na klient to na moto oyo azali na ndingisa — kaka yango ekoki kofutisama. Ekomami na ndenge mosusu na ezongisami ; endimami + ezongisami ekoki koleka te motango epesami.

retourne.label: Ezongisami
retourne.description: Motango ezongisami, endimami te — etikali komonana, ekofutisa te. Ekomami na ndenge mosusu na endimami ; endimami + ezongisami ekoki koleka te motango epesami.

manquant.label: Ezangi
manquant.description: Bokeseni oyo serveur asali motángo : etiami mi na epesami. Etikali komonana, ekofutisa te, ekomami na klient te.

facturable.label: Ekofutisa
facturable.description: Motango oyo ekofutisa ezali motango endimami, kozanga ndelo ya esengami — komande moko kaka mpo na endimi moko.

RETENIR_PRODUCTION.label: Kopona mpo na bosali
RETENIR_PRODUCTION.description: Endimisi motango oyo eponami mpo na bosali, kowuta na oyo elobamaki liboso.

CONFIRMER_PREPARATION.label: Kondima elambami
CONFIRMER_PREPARATION.description: Endimisi motango elambami mpo na kotinda, esili kozala pene ya kopesama na Magasin.

CONFIRMER_REMISE_MAGASIN.label: Kondima epesami na Magasin
CONFIRMER_REMISE_MAGASIN.description: Endimisi motango epesami kowuta na Bosali kino na Magasin. Transition oyo endimisaka kaka bopesi ya kati, klient azwi yango nanu te.

CONFIRMER_CHARGEMENT.label: Kondima etiami
CONFIRMER_CHARGEMENT.description: Endimisi motango epesami na chauffeur mpo na mobembo mpe elobi nkombo ya chauffeur — endimisaka te ete klient azwi yango.

CONFIRMER_DEPART.label: Kondima kokende
CONFIRMER_DEPART.description: Endimisi ete chauffeur akei na mobembo elongo na kotinda. Ata motango moko ekomamaka te na etape oyo.

SIGNALER_DEPOT.label: Koyebisa epesami epai ya klient
SIGNALER_DEPOT.description: Eyebisi ete kotinda epesami epai ya klient. Motango endimami esengeli kondimama na esika mosusu — ebimisaka mbongo te na etape oyo.
